The box states a power rating of 1000-1200W.
Icons on the box indicate a 'Gold Finish Soleplate' and 'Thermostat Control'.
A '2 Year Warranty' seal is visible on the box.
The actual iron is not visible outside of the box.
The box is resting on another box for a Black+Decker iron.
A watermark 'BEST TIME ELECTRONICS' is present on the image.
Faint text '750W' is visible in the background above the box, which does not match the box specifications.
